Amendment of section 9 of Sindh Act XIV of 1973

SINDH CIVIL SERVANTS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
SINDH CIVIL
SERVANTS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE IV OF 2002
An Ordinance to
amend the Sindh Civil Servants Act, 1973
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part I 22nd January, 2002]
No. S. LEGIS: 1(4)/2002, dated
22‑1‑2002.‑‑‑The following Ordinance made by
the Governor of Sindh is hereby published for general information:‑‑
1. Short title and
commencement.‑‑‑(1) This Ordinance may be called the
Sindh Civil Servants (Amendment) Ordinance, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Short title and commencement

SINDH CIVIL SERVANTS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
SINDH CIVIL
SERVANTS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE IV OF 2002
An Ordinance to
amend the Sindh Civil Servants Act, 1973
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part I 22nd January, 2002]
No. S. LEGIS: 1(4)/2002, dated
22‑1‑2002.‑‑‑The following Ordinance made by
the Governor of Sindh is hereby published for general information:‑‑
2. Amendment of section 9 of
Sindh Act XIV of 1973.‑‑In the Sindh Civil Servants Act, 1973
after section 9, the following new section shall be inserted:
"9‑A. Notwithstanding
anything contained in this Act or any other law for the time being in force or
any judgment of any Court, a civil servant who provenly exhibits, the act of
gallantry while performing his duties or very exceptional performance beyond
the call of duty, may be granted out of turn promotion or award or reward in
such manner as may be prescribed."
